scope_method_attack.producer_method: Aggregate all six modules' baseline/kept tasks, then apply that single aggregate ratio to all 172,321,077 eligible cycles.
scope_method_attack.required_method: For every module, multiply its frozen cycle count by kept_tasks/baseline_tasks using an exact rational, then sum the six projected cycle terms.
scope_method_attack.severity: P1 methodology defect, not P0, because the numerical error is small and no 1.15 crossing decision changes.

g4_beta48.decision: NO_GO_1P15; retain only as a shared-engine paired-accuracy point

g4_beta64.decision: PAIRED_ACCURACY_SCREEN_ONLY; 66.17% deletion is an aggressive cliff, not hardware admission

population_and_bound_semantics.interpretation: The exact per-module arithmetic is a cross-population sensitivity: M51 task fractions are overlaid on M221 cycle weights. The beta bound cannot be translated to float/AEE without row scales and downstream propagation.

fc1_coexistence.shared_mechanism_case: A destination-group maximum-absolute-weight mask can share descriptor format, mask lookup and task-elision control between FC1 and patch Conv while each operator retains its own source geometry.
fc1_coexistence.reference_fc1_candidate: independently reviewed FC1 group8/beta96; accuracy and executable cycles remain false
fc1_coexistence.decision: Do not build a separate Conv-only lossy block for beta<=32. If the FC1 mask/compactor survives paired accuracy, add Conv as a shared descriptor/operator mode and test g4 beta48 first. G4 beta64 is only a stress point because it deletes 66.17% of weighted tasks and carries a 28,672-unit raw bound.
fc1_coexistence.claim_boundary: These combined values are disjoint-cycle opportunity overlays, not same-population simulations, executable cycles, accuracy results or system speedups.

p1.finding: M293 labels its Amdahl values scope-correct although it applies one aggregate task ratio uniformly to six unequal frozen module cycle weights.
p1.impact: Replace all published M293 sensitivity cells with exact per-module weighting. The maximum correction is 37.284 ppm and no first-crossing decision changes; G4/beta48 is 1.114622307, not 1.114631523.

p1.finding: M51 and M221 are different activity populations: summed active inputs differ by 3.090% and the maximum module difference is 4.613%.
p1.impact: Even exact per-module rational weighting is a cross-population opportunity sensitivity, not a same-population or executable cycle result.

p1.finding: G4/beta64 is the first group-4 point above 1.15 only after deleting 66.17% of weighted tasks with a 28,672-unit conservative raw INT8 bound.
p1.impact: There is no modified-forward accuracy, dequantized error or AEE guarantee. It cannot trigger RTL, valid825 or a paper performance claim.

p1.finding: The 1.588x and 2.956x ratios count ideal kept source/group tasks and omit mask fetch, scan, compaction, bank conflicts, accumulator service, commit and fallback overhead.
p1.impact: No task ratio or Amdahl overlay is an achieved hardware speedup until an explicit cycle adapter exists.

p2.finding: At beta<=32 the best group-4 point removes only 11.19% of weighted tasks and yields 1.03208x full-envelope opportunity.
p2.impact: A Conv-only low-beta implementation is not worth its own mask/router hardware; reuse an FC1 mechanism if one is admitted.

p2.finding: G4/beta48 removes 37.02% but remains below the 1.15 standalone gate at 1.11462x.
p2.impact: It is the least aggressive useful Conv accuracy probe and gains strategic value only through shared FC1+Conv control.

p2.finding: Per-output-row quantization uses distinct float scales while deterministic bounds are reported only in raw integer accumulator units.
p2.impact: Keep per-row scales in any modified-forward evaluator and never compare or sum raw bounds across rows as if normalized.

publication_wording.safe: Across 60 frozen binary patch-Conv payloads, bounded destination-group elision reproduces 1,774,268,587 3x3 source contributions. Exact six-module cycle weighting gives G4/beta48 a 1.1146x full-compute-envelope opportunity and G4/beta64 1.2252x; both remain analytical cross-population sensitivities without accuracy or executable compaction evidence.
forbidden: the raw INT8 accumulator bound proves float output or AEE
the FC1 plus Conv overlay is a cycle simulation
all eight patch Conv modules are optimized

required_fix: Replace aggregate-ratio Amdahl arithmetic with the sealed exact per-module 5x9 table.
Run paired modified-forward accuracy before choosing any beta; use G4/beta48 as the first Conv probe and hard-fail beta64 if accuracy is unacceptable.
If FC1 survives its own accuracy gate, share the destination-group mask/descriptor mechanism instead of building a Conv-only low-beta unit.
Before hardware or paper promotion, build one explicit mask-fetch/compaction/bank/accumulator cycle adapter and replay the same population as its cycle denominator.
